Shanthi Krishna Assistant ProfessorB.Sc (Sri Sarada College), MCA (Nehru Memorial College), M.Phil. (Manonmaniam Sundaranar University), PGP-AIML (Great Lakes Executive Learning) Linkedin Link She is an experienced academician with over 19 years in collegiate teaching, specialising in Computer Applications. She served as the Head of the Department from 2014 to December 2024 and currently serves as the IQAC Coordinator at SSMRV College since July 2024. She actively contributes to institutional committees and participates in professional development through research publications, FDPs, QIPs and workshops, promoting academic excellence and innovation.
